script:
-- rivals thing - esp aim fly (no dumb title)
-- e=esp q=aim f=fly (fly fast af)

local p=game:GetService("Players")
local r=game:GetService("RunService")
local i=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local w=game:GetService("Workspace")

local me=p.LocalPlayer
local cam=w.CurrentCamera
local m=me:GetMouse()

local esp=true
local aim=false
local fly=false
local flyspeed=50  -- fast fly
local bodyvel=nil

local esps={}

local function d(a,b)return(a-b).Magnitude end

-- esp box
local function box(plr)
	if plr==me then return end
	local c=plr.Character
	if not c then return end
	local root=c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end

	if esps[plr] then esps[plr]:Destroy() end

	local b=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	b.Name="espbox"
	b.Adornee=root
	b.Size=UDim2.new(0,6,0,3)
	b.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,4,0)
	b.AlwaysOnTop=true
	b.Parent=root

	local img=Instance.new("Frame")
	img.Size=UDim2.new(4,0,6,0)
	img.Position=UDim2.new(-0.5,0,-1.5,0)
	img.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(0,1,0)
	img.BackgroundTransparency=0.4
	img.BorderSizePixel=0
	img.Parent=b

	esps[plr]=b
end

local function db(plr)
	if esps[plr] then
		esps[plr]:Destroy()
		esps[plr]=nil
	end
end

-- closest aim
local function closest()
	local best=nil
	local dist=999
	local myroot=me.Character and me.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not myroot then return nil end

	for _,pl in pairs(p:GetPlayers())do
		if pl~=me and pl.Character and pl.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")then
			local dd=d(myroot.Position,pl.Character.Head.Position)
			if dd<dist and dd<200 then
				best=pl
				dist=dd
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- aimbot
local shooting=false
i.InputBegan:Connect(function(k)
	if k.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		shooting=true
	end
end)
i.InputEnded:Connect(function(k)
	if k.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		shooting=false
	end
end)

r.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not aim or not shooting then return end
	local t=closest()
	if t and t.Character and t.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")then
		local head=t.Character.Head.Position
		local sp=cam:WorldToScreenPoint(head)
		local mx,my=m.X,m.Y
		local dx=sp.X-mx
		local dy=sp.Y-my
		if math.abs(dx)<400 and math.abs(dy)<400 then
			mousemoverel(dx*0.15,dy*0.15)
		end
	end
end)

-- fly
local function togglefly()
	local char=me.Character
	if not char then return end
	local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end

	fly=not fly
	if fly then
		bodyvel=Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bodyvel.MaxForce=Vector3.new(4000,4000,4000)
		bodyvel.Velocity=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
		bodyvel.Parent=root
	else
		if bodyvel then bodyvel:Destroy() end
		bodyvel=nil
		root.Velocity=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
	end
end

r.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not fly or not me.Character or not bodyvel then return end
	local root=me.Character.HumanoidRootPart
	local move=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
	if i:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)then move=move+cam.CFrame.LookVector end
	if i:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S)then move=move-cam.CFrame.LookVector end
	if i:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A)then move=move-cam.CFrame.RightVector end
	if i:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D)then move=move+cam.CFrame.RightVector end
	local up=0
	if i:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)then up=1 end
	if i:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)then up=-1 end
	bodyvel.Velocity=(move*flyspeed)+(cam.CFrame.UpVector*up*flyspeed)
end)

-- keys
i.InputBegan:Connect(function(k)
	if k.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.E then
		esp=not esp
		if esp then
			for _,pl in pairs(p:GetPlayers())do box(pl) end
		else
			for _,pl in pairs(p:GetPlayers())do db(pl) end
		end
	elseif k.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Q then
		aim=not aim
	elseif k.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.F then
		togglefly()
	end
end)

-- players
p.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(pl)
	pl.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		wait(1)
		if esp then box(pl) end
	end)
end)
p.PlayerRemoving:Connect(db)

for _,pl in pairs(p:GetPlayers())do
	if pl.Character then box(pl) end
	pl.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()wait(1)if esp then box(pl)end end)
end

-- gui no title
wait(1)
local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Parent=me:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local boxx=Instance.new("Frame")
boxx.Size=UDim2.new(0,160,0,100)
boxx.Position=UDim2.new(0,5,0,5)
boxx.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(0.05,0.05,0.05)
boxx.BorderSizePixel=1
boxx.BorderColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
boxx.Active=true
boxx.Draggable=true
boxx.Parent=gui

local ebtn=Instance.new("TextButton")
ebtn.Size=UDim2.new(0.85,0,0,25)
ebtn.Position=UDim2.new(0.075,0,0.15,0)
ebtn.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(0,0.8,0)
ebtn.Text="ESP ON"
ebtn.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
ebtn.Font=Enum.Font.SourceSans
ebtn.Parent=boxx

local abtn=Instance.new("TextButton")
abtn.Size=UDim2.new(0.85,0,0,25)
abtn.Position=UDim2.new(0.075,0,0.45,0)
abtn.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(0.8,0,0)
abtn.Text="AIM OFF"
abtn.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
abtn.Font=Enum.Font.SourceSans
abtn.Parent=boxx

local fbtn=Instance.new("TextButton")
fbtn.Size=UDim2.new(0.85,0,0,25)
fbtn.Position=UDim2.new(0.075,0,0.75,0)
fbtn.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(0,0.5,1)
fbtn.Text="FLY OFF"
fbtn.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
fbtn.Font=Enum.Font.SourceSans
fbtn.Parent=boxx

ebtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	esp=not esp
	ebtn.Text="ESP "..(esp and "ON" or "OFF")
	ebtn.BackgroundColor3=esp and Color3.new(0,0.8,0) or Color3.new(0.3,0.3,0.3)
	if esp then
		for _,pl in pairs(p:GetPlayers())do box(pl) end
	else
		for _,pl in pairs(p:GetPlayers())do db(pl) end
	end
end)

abtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	aim=not aim
	abtn.Text="AIM "..(aim and "ON" or "OFF")
	abtn.BackgroundColor3=aim and Color3.new(0.8,0,0) or Color3.new(0.3,0.3,0.3)
end)

fbtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	togglefly()
	fbtn.Text="FLY "..(fly and "ON" or "OFF")
	fbtn.BackgroundColor3=fly and Color3.new(0,0.8,0) or Color3.new(0,0.5,1)
end)

print("rivals - e q f")
